```{r}
#| include: false
source("0_set_up.R")
source("R/codebook.R")
source("R/page_helpers.R")   # aa_stats_html()
version <- "2025"
if (Sys.getenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true") update_aa_data()
aa_data <- import(glue("data/aa_data_wide_nogeo_{version}.rds"), trust = TRUE)
labels  <- read.csv(glue("data/aa_data_wide_labels_{version}.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rows    <- codebook_rows(aa_data, labels)
yrs     <- range(aa_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)
cit     <- aa_citation(version, version_released)
fmt_date <- function(d) gsub("  ", " ", format(d, "%B %e, %Y"))
version_text <- paste0("Version ", version, " was released ", fmt_date(version_released),
                       if (!is.na(version_corrected)) paste0(" and corrected ", fmt_date(version_corrected)), ".")
```

::: {.aa-intro}
# Codebook

Every variable in the Active Attack Data, version `{r} version`: what it records, its values, and how often it is missing.

The data have one row per attack, `{r} format_num(nrow(aa_data))` attacks from `{r} yrs[1]` through `{r} yrs[2]`, in `{r} ncol(aa_data)` variables. Counts below are from this version of the data. Download the data and this codebook on the [Active Attacks](1_visuals.html#download-the-data) page.
:::

::: {.cb-facts}
```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::asis_output(aa_stats_html(c("Attacks" = format_num(nrow(aa_data)), "Variables" = ncol(aa_data),
                                   "Years" = paste0(yrs[1], "\u2013", yrs[2]), "Version" = version)))
```

## How to read the data {.cb-h2}

::: {.cb-reading}
::: {.cb-reason}
### What counts as an active attack
An active attack occurs when an individual or individuals is actively killing or attempting to kill multiple unrelated people in a public space. The key word is *actively*: events that law enforcement learns of only after they end are excluded. Any weapon counts.
:::
::: {.cb-reason}
### Attacker variables
Age, sex and race carry a suffix for each attacker (`age_1`, `age_2`, `age_3`). For an attack with one attacker, the `_2` and `_3` variables are empty. The order is arbitrary.
:::
::: {.cb-reason}
### Inclusive counts
Variables ending in `_incl` use the FBI's more inclusive definition. ALERRT counts only people shot, wounded or killed by the attacker; an injury suffered while fleeing is not in `wound_tot`.
:::
::: {.cb-reason}
### Versions
`{r} version_text` Every change is listed under Updates on the [Home](index.html#updates) page.
:::
:::
